stance_rationale: Hard portfolio constraints and walk-forward schedule mostly pass, so there is no RF-O5/O6/O7/O13 critical block. Revision is still required because RF-R1 beta handling, top-alpha signal loss, CVaR fallback disclosure, Sequential Admission, and AX-008 artifact governance remain unresolved.

method_shopping_audit.selection_method: max net_ir subject to turnover_yr <= 6.0; Schedule_EWbase selected, AlphaSoftmax disqualified for turnover, but CVaR_LP is actually an ERC fallback when Rglpk is absent

cost_audit.cost_proportionality_check: PASS under the package's round-trip turnover convention: recomputed schedule turnover 5.3007 * 15bps = 0.795%, close to package 0.792%.

sequential_admission_audit.integration_weight_breakdown: Missing. Alpha-stage cross-sectional Spearman -0.024 vs PG2 is reported, but optimizer-level TDC, replacement, and 80/20 blended SR/MDD/IR are absent.

critical_concerns.description: AX-008 handoff is inconsistent: requested qepm/mailbox weights.csv and qepm/stage_artifacts covariance.parquet are absent, optimizer_challenge_note.md is absent, and the produced weights.csv uses stage_artifacts plus column method rather than the requested method_selected schema.

RF-R1 is measured but not controlled: as-of beta is 1.0916 and MKT variance share is 64.8%, while the feasible beta-cap variant reduces beta to 1.00 with +0.0745 one-way turnover and MDD 0.342 to 0.335. Rejecting it solely for netIR 0.980 to 0.950 leaves beta-drift mandate unresolved.

RF-O1 signal loss is material: latest target weights omit alpha ranks 2, 6, 10, 11, 12, 14, 15, 16, and 19; 24 of the top 35 alpha names have zero weight, while held names include ranks 119, 125, 144, and 237.

Method-shopping disclosure is incomplete: Rglpk is not installed and optimizer code falls back CVaR_LP to ERC, producing identical ERC/CVaR metrics, but the package does not issue a separate optimizer infeasibility report or method_shopping_log_optimizer.json.

Sequential Admission is missing at optimizer level: no TDC vs MEGA_05 or PG2 active book, no replacement scenario, and no integration blend SR/MDD/IR are reported despite L-219 family-saturation governance.

Crisis fallback is not explicit. Risk reports high-vol n=37 and regime diagnostics are thin; max weights are below 10% de facto, but there is no formal crisis boundary, cash-sleeve rule, or pooled-regime fallback decision.

supporting_arguments: stage_artifacts/WT_D20260528_003/weights.csv is a real time-series schedule: 2320 rows, 116 dates, 20 names per date, max weight 0.0682, no negative weights, and max abs sum-weight error 4.44e-16.
Selection objective is not raw Sharpe cherry-picking: selected Schedule_EWbase has net_ir 0.9797 under turnover feasibility, while AlphaSoftmax net_ir 1.0171 is disqualified for turnover 12.533.
The alternate PROD covariance at stage_artifacts/WT_D20260528_003_risk_PROD/covariance.parquet is PSD with min eigenvalue 0.0969 and condition number 100.0, and all target holdings are covered.
unresolved_disputes: Whether the stage_artifacts weights.csv and risk_PROD covariance paths are an accepted replacement for the user-specified mailbox/qepm-stage handoff paths.
Whether RF-R1 beta-cap should be mandatory when the as-of book breaches beta target despite lower walk-forward mean beta.
Whether bandbuffer turnover control justifies excluding many of the highest alpha names without an explicit alpha-opportunity-cost audit.
Whether a CVaR_LP candidate that silently falls back to ERC should count as a valid optimizer candidate.
Whether this can be treated as PROD when inherited alpha DSR is 3.05e-15 and full 5-spec robustness is still incomplete.
weakest_assumption: The weakest weight assumption is that the RF-R1 beta breach can be left uncapped because walk-forward mean beta is lower and the cap costs 0.03 net IR.
rebuttal_required: Create optimizer_challenge_note.md and method_shopping_log_optimizer.json with RF-O1~RF-O13 dispositions, Rglpk/CVaR fallback status, and all infeasibility cases.
Mirror weights.csv to the requested worktask path or formally update the handoff contract; use method_selected or document the schema deviation.
Mirror covariance.parquet to the requested qepm/stage_artifacts path or formally update lineage to risk_PROD and preserve PSD/cond<=100 evidence.
Provide beta-cap replacement and integration metrics under the beta target, including SR, IR, MDD, turnover, and explicit reason if cap remains rejected.
Quantify top-alpha exclusion cost versus bandbuffer turnover savings under 15bps one-way costs.
Report Sequential Admission TDC vs PG2/MEGA_05 and replacement vs 80/20 integration SR/MDD/IR.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: The numeric weight schedule is not the main failure; governance and risk-control translation are. A valid 116-date schedule does not close RF-R1, RF-O1, CVaR fallback disclosure, or Sequential Admission.

optimizer_specific_questions: Is the stage_artifacts weights.csv contractually equivalent to the requested qepm/mailbox weights.csv?
Why is beta-cap rejected when RF-R1 is HIGH and the cap is feasible with quantified MDD improvement?
How much net_IR is lost or gained if the omitted top-alpha names are forced into the 20-name book under turnover constraints?
Does CVaR_LP remain a valid candidate if it is ERC fallback due to missing Rglpk?
Where are the replacement and 80/20 integration metrics versus PG2 active book?
